close_reason: Fixed: moved build_email_from_create doc comment from above FORBIDDEN_KEYWORD_CHARS (line 1276) to directly above the function (line 1376). Added doc comments for new parse_mailbox_ids and parse_keywords_field helpers.
description: At email.rs line 1284-1303, the doc comment for build_email_from_create is followed immediately by FORBIDDEN_KEYWORD_CHARS and validate_and_normalize_keywords constants/functions with no closing doc. The doc says 'Assigns a thread id by searching existing emails... Validate and normalize a raw keyword map' — the doc comment runs into the wrong function. The intent is unclear: is validate_and_normalize_keywords described there or is this two functions whose doc was merged? Suggested rewrite: separate the doc comments so each function has its own /// block directly above it.
title: build_email_from_create doc comment is split across function boundary
